summary: On RD-1015 I deleted both parts via the row Delete buttons; each opened an in-page "Confirm" modal with Cancel/Delete part, which I confirmed, and the parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." I then clicked 'Archive ticket': the app archived it immediately — no confirmation prompt and, contrary to the expectation, no complaint about Ready status with no parts; the button changed to 'Unarchive ticket'. On the tickets list (Search=RD-1015, Show archived unchecked) the ticket no longer appears ("No tickets match the current filters."); with Show archived checked the row appears as RD-1015, "fwrd94-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived", Bench User, Ready, Parts 0, Created 2026-09-25.
